events.text_en: Two of Lạc Hà's alchemists found Yên Quang Các on the steppe below its seat and swear to pick their herbs only in the hour of the evening glow.

In the great drought, with the Dusk Field's wormwood thinned, Vi Ngưng Yên, founder of Yên Quang Các, dies in her breakthrough to Nguyên Anh; her Dao partner, who made her pill, refuses the headship and never lights a furnace again.
Yên Quang Các carries its founder's furnace, still lit, from the steppe to the wild mulberry wood by Tang Ma Thành; the steppe becomes its Dusk Field.
